subject: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK streaming, tool-calling, structured outputs) - draft & owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (integration milestones)

Thanks Samantha & Tom — great call today. Quick recap and next steps:

- Goals: integrate Redwood SDK for streaming responses, enable tool-calling hooks, and emit structured outputs for downstream parsing.
- Immediate blocker: finalizing the SDK auth flow and confirming whether Acme will host token exchange or use Redwood-managed short-lived tokens.
- Proposed target close for PO: 2026-11-15 (matches Q4 integration calendar).

I've attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (ACME-Redwood-MAP-v0.3.docx) and an integration checklist (integration_sdk_checklist.xlsx). Please review owners/milestones below and flag any gaps.

MAP integration milestone (draft):
1) SDK auth & onboarding (owner: Acme infra / Ben) — due 2026-10-15 — dependency: access to Acme dev AWS account
2) Streaming + prefix handling (owner: Marissa) — due 2026-10-29 — dependency: confirm max sequence length and latency SLOs
3) Tool-calling integration (owner: Dev) — due 2026-11-05 — dependency: tool endpoints & auth
4) Structured outputs & schema (owner: Rishi / Acme PM) — due 2026-11-08 — dependency: final schema from Acme
5) End-to-end demo + signoff (owner: Ben / Acme PM) — target 2026-11-12

Please reply with any changes to owners or due dates. If this looks good, we'll convert to v0.4 and lock milestones for the SOW.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: ACME-Redwood-MAP-v0.3.docx (docx, 120KB), integration_sdk_checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (integration milestones)

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear rundown. A few quick notes from our side:

- Acme will handle token exchange in our infra (we prefer to keep CI tokens in-house). Ben, can you outline the Redwood SDK changes for that model?
- Tool-calling: Tom will share the top 3 tool endpoints (search, inventory, price-check) by EOD 10/05.
- Schema: we'll push the first draft of the structured outputs schema by 10/06 (Tom will own).

The timeline looks reasonable; the only ask is to move the streaming milestone one week later to 2026-11-05 to allow for our latency tests.

Samantha
Samantha Lee | Senior PM, Platform Integrations
Acme Corp
samantha.lee@acme.com | +1 (650) 555-9876

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (integration milestones)

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Samantha. Confirming changes below and next steps:

- Streaming milestone moved to 2026-11-05 (per Acme latency testing) — owner remains Marissa.
- Ben will drop an SDK auth design note by 10/07 outlining the token-exchange handshake and edge cases for short-lived tokens when Acme handles exchange.
- Tom: will look for the tool endpoints and schema drafts; once received, Dev and Rishi will triage and update dependencies.

I'll update the MAP to v0.4 and re-share. If everyone is aligned, Ben will schedule a technical kickoff the week of 10/12 (Marissa/Dev/Rishi + Acme platform).

On the kickoff: proposed agenda — 1) SDK auth flow review, 2) streaming perf expectations and test plan, 3) tool API contract & security, 4) structured output schema finalization.

Ben

> On Thu, Oct 1, 2026 at 4:12 PM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Thanks Samantha & Tom — great call today. Quick recap and next steps:
> > ...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (integration milestones)

Thanks all — assigning engineering owners & clarifying tasks on the MAP v0.4 (attached). High level notes:

- SDK auth & onboarding (owner: Ben / Acme infra) — Redwood action: provide spec + sample implementation by 10/07 (Ben). Acme action: provide dev AWS account access by 10/12.
- Streaming (owner: Marissa) — deliverables: SDK streaming example, perf test harness, baseline latency report. Due 2026-11-05. Redwood will run an initial perf run with Acme test vectors within 3 business days of receiving vectors.
- Tool-calling (owner: Dev) — implement tool adapter shim and security review checklist. Dependency: tool contract from Acme. Target 2026-11-05 (aligning with streaming).
- Structured outputs (owner: Rishi + Tom) — Rishi to create Redwood JSON-LD schema template by 10/08; Tom to provide Acme schema and examples by 10/06. Finalize by 10/11.
- Risks & mitigation: if Acme tool endpoints are behind VPN, schedule a secure tunnel test on first week of 11/01.

I've attached MAP v0.4 and a pared-down integration checklist. Ben — can you confirm the kickoff date availability for the week of 10/12? I'll block tentative times once you confirm internal attendees.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole | Director, Integrations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: ACME-Redwood-MAP-v0.4.docx (docx, 140KB), integration_sdk_checklist_v0.2.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)
